verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents two natural-language paths. Composer is in-app: you 'tell Composer what you're trying to achieve' and it builds the audience, drafts content and maps the send strategy. The official MCP server lets an AI agent like Claude or Cursor carry out prompts such as 'Create an email campaign promoting our Memorial Day sale', from campaign creation to flow reports. A probe confirms the MCP docs page exists, and pricing lists scheduling tasks, creating campaigns and flows, and getting answers from data. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that NL commands work reliably, and documentation of which 'supported changes' Composer can and cannot make.
